label: Jobicy
terms_note: Free, keyless; fair-use rule = keep attribution + redirect applicants to the original job URL; MCP endpoint offered for AI tools.
official_mcp: Jobicy MCP endpoint (documented on the Jobs API page; URL behind the 'MCP server' section)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (search; REST + MCP + RSS) Confidence high (official Jobs API page opened).

endpoints.notes: geo (country / region list), industry (dev, marketing, supporting…)
remote job search for AI tools

endpoints.call: RSS filtered feeds (section on the page)

reference.limits: - Fair use: 'Do not present Jobicy listings as your own original job postings or remove source attribution'; application buttons must redirect to the original job URL (2026-09-02 audit quote). - Free, no key; no numeric rate limit on the page.
mcp_sdk: Jobicy MCP endpoint (official, documented on the Jobs API page)

search_postings.note: Keyless ('No API key … No account or authentication header is required'). location must be a Jobicy location slug (?get=locations lists them); there is no page parameter — count is the whole result set, so page > 1 repeats it. Jobicy asks that stored listings be re-checked only 'once or twice per hour'. An official MCP server also exists at https://jobicy.com/mcp. Mirrors jobs/jobicy: category is sent as industry (documented filters: count, geo, industry, tag). buyer is the hiring company; salaryMin/Max map to budget_min/max.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: No per-id endpoint is documented; the feed returns whole records.
not_offered.submit_bid: Fair use: 'redirect applicants to the original job URL' — no application or bid API.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
